title: MongoDB ObjectId
summary: A MongoDB ObjectId is a 12-byte (96-bit) identifier: a 4-byte Unix timestamp (seconds), a 5-byte random value per process, and a 3-byte incrementing counter. Rendered as 24 lowercase hex characters.

notes: random: 5 bytes, generated once per process.
counter: 3 bytes, big-endian, incremented per id.
Total 12 bytes -> 24 hex chars; roughly time-sortable.
